description: POST HTML or a public URL. Strips scripts, styles, nav and footers, converts to Markdown and returns heading-aware chunks with heading paths, token estimates, stable hashes and configurable overlap. For embedding and RAG pipelines. Tables become GitHub-flavored Markdown; nested tables become labelled sub-tables. Full rules: https://johtodata.com/services/url-to-markdown/ Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
name: html_to_rag
title: Johto Data HTML to RAG
